title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Protocol Error Close Work Item
summary: Add an opt-in server-side tunnel context helper that converts malformed WebSocket parser failures into protocol-error close frames before rethrowing.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext.ReadMessageOrCloseOnProtocolErrorAsync` to wrap parser-backed reads.
- On `Http3ErrorCode.MessageError`, write close status 1002 with a protocol-error reason, complete writes, and rethrow the parser failure.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that sends an unmasked client frame, verifies the client receives a 1002 close frame and FIN, and verifies the handler observed the parser failure.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket protocol-error test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, the RFC 9220 WebSocket parser tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Automatic close-code mapping for arbitrary handler exceptions.
QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: The accepted tunnel context can now convert malformed WebSocket frame parser failures to explicit 1002 close frames when handlers opt into the helper.
